title: Fort Psycho #4
desc:
LET'S GO, PSYCHO! It's spy versus spy, traitor versus traitor, and eagle-eyed writer Matt Kindt (BRZRKR, Mind MGMT) versus hot-shot artist Brian Hurtt (The Sixth Gun) as FORT PSYCHO's master class in danger and deceit makes a run for it!

After an unlikely alliance, Jason needs to recruit the rest of his fellow former agents and ex-allies. His plan? To break out of the island prison nicknamed "Fort Psycho" and destroy the global conspiracy that put him there. But even for the world's most feared covert operatives, this is the suicide mission to end all suicide missions. Every minute and every man is going to count. But can an island full of professional deceivers and cold-eyed killers ever truly trust one another? Or is their entire escape about to explode like ten million tons of TNT?
